suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the ErrNotFound repository pattern for consistent 404 handling. When a requested entity is not found, repositories should return a typed ErrNotFound error rather than formatted error strings, enabling handlers to easily translate to proper HTTP 404 responses.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature api-get-evaluation fixed repository GetByID method to return repository.ErrNotFound instead of fmt.Errorf format. This pattern was applied correctly but is not documented.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add verification commands to the services documentation (e.g., docker exec for psql, redis-cli for redis) to make the verification workflow explicit for workers.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature api-create-evaluation used docker exec eval-postgres psql -c 'SELECT...' for DB verification and docker exec eval-redis redis-cli GET... for Redis verification. These are not documented in services.yaml.
